scopeNotes: Oppia: the public card describes the three-participant topic-page study. The CV claim of 60+ students across 10+ schools is a separate, unresolved scope and is not combined or published on the card.
Fedora dates January–October 2026 are sourced from the data-science CV. Contribution work is not described as an internship; no upstream code merge is asserted.
Docling OCR and RamaLama documentation, previously separate archive rows, are grouped under one Fedora card with both showcase and OCR repository links.
Financial Guardian: group project using synthetic data. Individual data preparation, analysis and visualization contributions are sourced from the data-science CV.
Renewable Energy: the public repository is a fork of the collaborative project. README and CV support electricity trends and SARIMAX, not the old solar-yield/Prophet summary.
Aviation: README credits Janine as author. Present as exploratory analysis; do not infer comparative safety rates from incident counts without exposure data.
No private repositories or inaccessible evidence were assumed absent. Unresolved entries remain for user follow-up.
